_meta.purpose: Reconciles the 13 dataset target_failure_type values against the 23 alarm codes AlarmService raises, so diagnosis and prediction never disagree about what a fault is called. Frozen artifact (sprint_plan 3.md §5), authored by Dhanuja.
_meta.coverageRule: Every one of the 23 alarm codes must appear exactly once, either in an entry's alarmCodes[] or in diagnosisOnlyAlarmCodes[]. Nethmini's coverage test asserts this.
_meta.predictableMeaning: true = the dataset labels a pre-failure window for this type, so a model can forecast it. false = no dependable telemetry precursor (fire/intruder) or the alarm has no corresponding dataset target (diagnosis only).

entries.note: GEN_CRITICAL_FUEL is the escalated state of GEN_LOW_FUEL and shares the same diagnosis and corrective workflow.
Rename only: dataset GEN_OVERHEAT == code GEN_HIGH_TEMP.
Rename only: dataset GEN_VOLTAGE_INSTABILITY == code GEN_VOLTAGE_ABNORMAL.
One-character mismatch: dataset ...FAILURE vs code ...FAIL. The dataset contains active examples but no six-hour precursor labels, so this is diagnosis-only.
Supply loss manifests as MDP_PHASE_VOLTAGE. It is an upstream cascade with no six-hour precursor labels and is handled reactively.
SDP_PHASE_VOLTAGE resolves to SDP_BREAKER_TRIP when isolated. Correlation with an upstream MDP or ATS supply alarm resolves it to SDP_SUPPLY_LOSS.
Shares SDP_PHASE_VOLTAGE with SDP_BREAKER_TRIP and is selected only when an upstream MDP or ATS supply alarm is active. It has no six-hour precursor labels.
Input power loss forces the UPS onto battery. Suppress the alarm during a successful ATS source change; otherwise diagnose it reactively because it has no six-hour precursor labels.
The predictor forecasts battery degradation. UPS_BATTERY_LOW and UPS_BATTERY_CRITICAL are its operational escalation states and share the same battery inspection workflow.
Rename only: dataset UPS_OVERLOAD == code UPS_HIGH_LOAD (load > 80%).
Dataset has one FIRE_ALARM type; the system raises a per-equipment fire code. Not forecastable — catalogue states no telemetry precursor. Excluded from model training (sprint_plan 3.md §6 rule 5).
As FIRE_ALARM. Digital input, no precursor. Diagnosis only.

diagnosisOnlyAlarmCodes.note: Generic generator fault / fail-to-start. No corresponding dataset target_failure_type. Diagnosis catalogue must still cover it.
Mains voltage outside 207–253 V. No dataset target. Diagnosis only.
Generic UPS operational fault. No dataset target. Diagnosis only.

decisions: Only fault types with non-active six-hour precursor labels are forecastable.
Escalated fuel and battery alarm codes share their parent fault-family diagnosis.
UPS_ON_BATTERY is suppressed during a successful ATS transfer.
SDP_PHASE_VOLTAGE is disambiguated using upstream alarm correlation.
